next_diagnostic_steps: Preserve evidence and treat overnight reliability as unresolved. Do not interpret the earlier two-hour energy extrapolation as validated endurance.

Prepare failure-oriented capture before a supervised repeat: detailed PM phase messages and durable pre/post markers; assess an available persistent crash backend. An in-RAM trace alone is lost on reset, and pstore only captures supported crash paths, not every hang.

Use short battery tests with AC/peripherals removed while awake and the exact removal timing recorded; repeat the sleep/wake sequence to check state retained across cycles before another overnight run.

If reproducible, use staged freezer/devices/platform pm_test checks to isolate driver transitions from actual s2idle entry. The installed source supports these s2idle stages and rejects processors/core. Restore none after each diagnostic sequence. Tests require saved work and supervision and were not run during this review.
On recurrence, record indicators and short-button response, and try AC reconnection before any long power-button hold. Establish whether the original session resumes or a fresh boot starts.
